issues.before: Sus nueve artículos describían de qué maneras alguien no puede dejar de actuar
issues.after: Sus nueve artículos explicaban qué implica para alguien ese «no poder no» al actuar
issues.source_issue: 原行动论写一个人不得不怎样做，不是说任何人都不能停止行动；避免将具体/分型的不得不预先写成被批判的无退出马达。

issues.before: «No puedes sino darte ley únicamente a ti mismo»
issues.after: «El “no poder no” legisla únicamente para uno mismo»
issues.source_issue: 原引语主语是不得不这一自立之法，只为本人立法；不添对每个读者No puedes的直接普遍强制命令。引语仍作为被审原句，后面的语用问题保留。 修后读回发现no solo歧义；给术语加内引号并用únicamente明确仅为本人立法，最终保存段须再次实读。

issues.before: Poder parar y, aun así, seguir es autonomía; seguir sin poder parar es solo una máquina girando
issues.after: Solo si se puede parar y, aun así, se sigue, puede hablarse de autonomía; seguir sin poder parar es solo una máquina girando
issues.source_issue: 能停而不辍，才是自律是必要条件，不是足以认证自律；第09讲明确能停不辍也可能执迷。保only-if而不把原句加重成充分条件，机器半句不变。

issues.before: Si su ley nunca hubiera contenido esa cláusula
issues.after: Si su ley no hubiera contenido esa cláusula en ese momento
issues.source_issue: 原法里本无这一条指此次行动时，不要求整个人生从未有过这一条；不加nunca的跨时条件，保法可修订与当时账目之分。

issues.before: Dejar ceder algo no cambia su condición de valor.
issues.after: Dejar algo de lado esta vez no cambia su condición de valor.
issues.source_issue: Dejar ceder搭配像允许某物屈服，不自然；原让掉一项不改被让项价值地位，以此次搁置而非构成退出清楚表述。

issues.before: no el alcance de su posición
issues.after: no la fuerza de su condición normativa
issues.source_issue: 原地位强度，不是位置的作用范围；保能力下降不降规范地位。

issues.before: la ley del rechazante no impide
issues.after: la ley de quien rechaza esta propuesta no impide
issues.source_issue: 自然西语明确只拒本书这一支的法，不是声称拒整个SAE框架。

issues.after: Puede reducir considerablemente su credibilidad pública
issues.source_issue: 原可以显著削弱为可能，不把风险痕迹说成必定削弱。

actual_scope.finding: The action-theory series describes what practical no poder no implies, without turning it into a universal inability to stop acting. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

The first readback identified that no solo could attach to legisla and suggest not only. This was reported rather than passed. The lead editor then saved El “no poder no” legisla únicamente para uno mismo. I actually reread the whole saved paragraph: the term is now explicitly the subject, únicamente restricts legislative scope to oneself, and the following pragmatic/self-application question and old philosopher-king quotation remain intact.

Solo si retains a necessary condition, not a sufficient certification of autonomy; the motor/condition/person distinction and machine half of the old quotation remain. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

En ese momento limits the absence of the promise clause to the relevant action time, not an entire immutable lifetime. The friend's disappointment remains a consequence distinct from the actor's own cost. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

Dejar algo de lado esta vez is natural and preserves this-instance yielding without changing the value's status, while active invalidation after applicability remains a different case. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

Fuerza de su condición normativa conveys status thickness/strength rather than territorial or operative reach; decreased exercise capacity does not reduce status. All three scopes, infant/third-party precaution, recorded AI claim and unresolved animal comparison remain. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

Quien rechaza esta propuesta naturally identifies refusal of this book's proposal, not all SAE. The harm/institution boundary, explicit four-source reconstruction and cited supports remain. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

Puede reducir retains possible public-credibility reduction rather than asserting an inevitable result. The independently verified necessary condition and its failure, mere risk traces versus negative judgment, limited internal inference, and retractability remain distinct. Complete paragraph and Chinese source actually read.

post_application.limits: This records eight affected complete-paragraph source comparisons and the subsequent second full read of ep01[10]. It does not claim a new independent reread of all twelve Spanish essays or a human native-speaker certification.
